title: Signature Utility Draft Doctrine
description: A Signature-original drafting doctrine for utility patents: state the technical problem in one paragraph, the inventive step in one sentence, and the broadest claim first — then narrow in dependent claims like a funnel. The doctrine requires a working prototype note before filing, because a claim you cannot build is a claim you cannot defend. Signature-original; his own draft specs live in the Spec Catalog, this is the method layer.

title: Signature Design Capture Method
description: A Signature-original method for design protection: photograph or render the article from seven canonical angles, trace the ornamental lines that repeat across angles, and claim exactly those lines with everything else in broken lines. The method keeps a dated design log so the filing date story is airtight. Signature-original.

title: Signature Provisional Sprint
description: A Signature-original 12-month provisional sprint: file the provisional the week the prototype works, calendar the 12-month deadline with 90/30/7-day warnings, and spend the year reducing the claims to their testable core. The sprint treats the provisional as a clock, not a shield. Signature-original.

title: Signature PCT Decision Ladder
description: A Signature-original decision ladder for going international: file PCT only when two or more foreign markets are real (not aspirational), use the international search report as the go/no-go gate, and enter national phase in revenue order. title: Signature Continuation Discipline

title: Signature Reissue Audit
description: A Signature-original audit for granted patents: re-read the claims against the shipping product every two years, and file a broadening reissue within the two-year window if the claims undershoot the product. The audit catches the common failure of patents that protect last year's design. Signature-original.
